name: This One Room
source:
Renz and Mary Natalie are just two ordinary people who are trapped in a room. But this ain't a mystery escape-the-room story, mind you!

[From [URL=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/this-one-room]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
伦兹与玛丽·娜塔莉只是两个被困在同一间屋子里的普通人。不过，先说好，这可不是什么悬疑密室逃脱故事！

[摘自[URL=https://dagitabsoft.itch.io/this-one-room]itch.io[/URL]]
